messages.content: Write one SYNTHETIC diplomatic utterance, not a quotation or reconstruction. Preserve ALL required conditions, numbers, actor roles, channel and commitment strength. Use generic we/you, not actual country names. A historical source only supplies discourse context. Do not copy unsupported historical details. Return an utterance under 65 words in a direct private negotiating-room statement style.

{"source": "We affirm the imperative of realizing an immediate and sustained ceasefire in Gaza over a period of at least six weeks as part of a deal that would release hostages held by Hamas and allow for delivery of essential additional humanitarian assistance to Palestinians in need.", "synthetic_required_meaning": "We will maintain a ceasefire for 1 weeks IF you maintain humanitarian access for 1 weeks. Our commitment depends on yours."}
